ows:ServiceIdentification.ows:Title: MAGPlot Sites and Trees
ows:ServiceIdentification.ows:Abstract: This WFS provides access to data products from the Multi-Agency Ground Plot (MAGPlot) dataset, v1.2.0. This nationally harmonized collection of forest ground plots was created through data submissions from collaborating jurisdictions and other agencies. Collaborators include the Government of Alberta, Government of British Columbia, Government of New Brunswick, Government of Northwestern Territories, Government of Ontario, Government of Prince Edward Island, Government of Quebec, Government of Yukon, and the National Forest Inventory.

FeatureType.Name: ms:Sites_Summary
FeatureType.Title: Site Summaries
FeatureType.Abstract: A summary of all measured MAGPlot sites, including the leading genus by stem count, most recent treatments applied, most recent disturbances reported, count of trees for the baseline measurement, and number of measurements. Sites requiring a signed data use agreement have been excluded from this view, contact nfisupport@nfis.org for access to those sites

FeatureType.Name: ms:BC_Trees_Measure_Num_0_pre_1972
FeatureType.Title: BC Trees Measurement 0 before 1972
FeatureType.Abstract: Trees measured at British Columbia sites for the baseline measurement of the site before 1972. Each site will have many overlapping points, each representing information for a single tree. Plots requiring signed Data Use Agreements for access have been excluded from this layer, submit requests to the NFI (nfisupport@nfis.org) team for access to these plots. Sources excluded: NFI, AB, NT.
